# `provider_usage_probe`

**Probe a provider's remaining quota.** Ask a provider's own CLI what is left of the account's limit windows and record the reading. Free to run and never billed against the quota it reports.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Capability | `provider_usage_probe` |
| Side effect | `create` |
| Idempotency | none |
| Retry safe | yes |
| Timeout | none |
| Preview | not supported |
| Defined in | [`src/commands/contracts/builtin.py`](../../../src/commands/contracts/builtin.py) |
| Contract fingerprint | `sha256:3d460c8d755a0decfcd0763955ff1de254d14960ced052b146bed649afaaad46` |
